verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented debugging capability: nothing on reproducing issues, running or inspecting failing code, or isolating root causes. The closest item is the Goal feature's generic 'planning, execution and verification' of multi-step work (zcode-docs-2). That is an adjacent task-management feature rather than a debugging or fix-verification workflow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes
